name: Camping Jungholz
beschreibung: Camping Jungholz is located in the municipality of the same name in Tirol. The facility offers pitches for campers and motorhomes. It is surrounded by forests and mountains. The site has sanitary facilities and a bread roll service. Hiking in summer or skiing in winter is possible in the region. The campsite is ideal for a quiet holiday. A nearby outdoor pool can also be used.
